request: what's the difference between speed and velocity?

beats.intent: A circular track with a runner dot moving round it
beats.narration: A runner goes round a circular track at a steady ten kilometres an hour.
beats.code:
stage.title("Speed and velocity")
track = Circle(radius=2.2, color=GREY_B).move_to([-1.5, -0.3, 0])
runner = Dot(track.point_from_proportion(0), color=YELLOW, radius=0.14)
stage.play(Create(track), GrowFromCenter(runner))
stage.add(track, runner)
stage.play(MoveAlongPath(runner, track), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)

beats.intent: Four velocity arrows around the track, all the same length but pointing different ways
beats.narration: Their speed never changes, but their direction does. Velocity is speed with a direction, so it keeps changing.
beats.code:
c = track.get_center()
arrows = []
for a in (0, PI / 2, PI, 3 * PI / 2):
    p = c + 2.2 * np.array([np.cos(a), np.sin(a), 0])
    t = np.array([-np.sin(a), np.cos(a), 0])
    arrows.append(Arrow(p, p + 1.3 * t, buff=0, color=GREEN))
stage.play(*[GrowArrow(a) for a in arrows])
stage.add(*arrows)
stage.caption("same length: same speed. Different directions: different velocity")

beats.intent: After one full lap, the runner back at the start: distance 400 m but displacement 0
beats.narration: After a full lap they have run four hundred metres, yet ended where they started: their average velocity is zero.

request: how do you cut a round cake fairly into 3?

beats.narration: A round cake, to be shared fairly between three people.
beats.code:
stage.title("Cutting a cake in three")
cake = Circle(radius=2.2, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to([-1.5, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(Create(cake))
stage.add(cake)

beats.intent: Three cuts from the centre at 120° apart, each slice coloured
beats.narration: A full turn is three hundred and sixty degrees. Cut from the centre every hundred and twenty degrees.
beats.code:
c = cake.get_center()
slices = VGroup(*[Sector(radius=2.2, start_angle=PI / 2 + k * TAU / 3, angle=TAU / 3, color=col, fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_color=WHITE)
                  .move_arc_center_to(c) for k, col in enumerate((RED, GREEN, BLUE))])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(s) for s in slices], lag_ratio=0.3))
stage.add(slices)
ang = Angle(Line(c, c + UP), Line(c, c + np.array([np.cos(PI / 2 + TAU / 3), np.sin(PI / 2 + TAU / 3), 0])), radius=0.6, color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(ang))
stage.add(ang)
stage.label(ang, "120°", direction=UL, color=YELLOW)

beats.narration: Three equal angles, so three equal slices.

request: why does a three-legged stool never wobble?

beats.intent: A four-legged table on bumpy ground with one leg in the air
beats.narration: On uneven ground a four-legged table often rocks: one leg is left hanging.
beats.code:
stage.title("Three legs never wobble")
ground = VMobject(color=GREY_B).set_points_smoothly([[-6, -2.2, 0], [-4.5, -2.0, 0], [-3, -2.35, 0], [-1.5, -2.1, 0], [0, -2.2, 0]])
stage.play(Create(ground))
stage.add(ground)
top = Line([-5.2, -0.4, 0], [-1.0, -0.4, 0], color=ORANGE, stroke_width=10)
legs = VGroup(*[Line([x, -0.4, 0], [x, yb, 0], color=ORANGE, stroke_width=6) for x, yb in ((-5.0, -2.08), (-3.6, -2.2), (-2.4, -2.18), (-1.2, -2.0))])
stage.play(Create(top), Create(legs))
stage.add(top, legs)
gap = Circle(radius=0.25, color=RED).move_to([-3.6, -2.22, 0])
stage.play(Create(gap))
stage.add(gap)
stage.caption("four legs: one can hang in the air")

beats.intent: A three-legged stool on the same ground with all three feet touching
beats.narration: A stool with three legs always touches with all three: any three points fix a flat plane for the seat to sit on.
beats.code:
ground2 = ground.copy().shift(6.2 * RIGHT)
stage.play(Create(ground2))
stage.add(ground2)
seat = Line([1.4, -0.3, 0], [4.8, -0.2, 0], color=GREEN, stroke_width=10)
feet = [ground2.point_from_proportion(p) for p in (0.18, 0.5, 0.82)]
tops = [seat.point_from_proportion(p) for p in (0.05, 0.5, 0.95)]
legs3 = VGroup(*[Line(t, f, color=GREEN, stroke_width=6) for t, f in zip(tops, feet)])
stage.play(Create(seat), Create(legs3))
stage.add(seat, legs3)
stage.caption("three legs: always all touching")

beats.intent: Three dots with a plane through them, beside: 3 points fix a plane
beats.narration: Three points, not in a line, always lie on exactly one plane. A fourth point usually doesn't.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
plane = Polygon([-2.5, -1.8, 0], [2.0, -1.4, 0], [3.0, 0.8, 0], [-1.5, 0.4, 0], color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.25)
stage.play(FadeIn(plane))
stage.add(plane)
for p in ([-1.2, -0.9, 0], [1.6, -0.8, 0], [0.8, 0.3, 0]):
    d = Dot(p, color=YELLOW, radius=0.12)
    stage.play(GrowFromCenter(d), run_time=0.3)
    stage.add(d)
odd = Dot([-0.3, 1.5, 0], color=RED, radius=0.12)
stage.play(GrowFromCenter(odd))
stage.add(odd)
stage.label(odd, "a 4th point: usually off the plane", direction=RIGHT, color=RED)

request: how do I convert between miles and kilometres?

beats.intent: Two number lines stacked: miles 0 to 5 on top, kilometres 0 to 8 below, lined up
beats.narration: Put a mile scale above a kilometre scale, lined up at zero.
beats.code:
stage.title("Miles and kilometres")
km_unit = 1.2
miles = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 5, 1], unit_size=km_unit * 1.609, include_numbers=True, color=ORANGE).move_to([0, 0.8, 0])
kms = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 8, 1], unit_size=km_unit, include_numbers=True, color=BLUE)
kms.shift(miles.n2p(0) - kms.n2p(0) + 1.6 * DOWN)
stage.play(Create(miles), Create(kms))
stage.add(miles, kms)
stage.label(miles, "miles", direction=LEFT, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(kms, "km", direction=LEFT, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: A dashed line from 5 miles down to 8.05 km
beats.narration: Five miles lines up with just over eight kilometres.
beats.code:
link = DashedLine(miles.n2p(5), kms.n2p(8.045), color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(link))
stage.add(link)
stage.caption("5 miles ≈ 8 km")

beats.intent: The scales beside 1 mile ≈ 1.609 km, km × 5/8 ≈ miles
beats.narration: One mile is about one point six kilometres. To go back, multiply kilometres by five eighths.
